pairs.why: B's larger navy barrel shows a broad soft sheen turning into a dark underside, like the real lamp; A's small barrel is flatter and thinner in form.
A has a sharp white hot spot on glossy plastic-looking gores, while B has softer sheen and darker shaded undersides, closer to the real canopy's form shadow.
A's housing has a clear light side, a deep shadow side and a soft rim, like the real lamp, while B's tiny lamp is flat with little form turn.
B has a darker, more grounded contact shadow on the table and a modeled shadow side on the fruit, closer to the real plate, though its droplet highlights are a bit sharp.
B's posts and planks have smooth, clear light-to-shadow turns and a soft cast shadow on the water, while A's busy caustic water pattern and flat posts feel texture-y.
A has the real card's soft dark cast shadow at lower left and a rounded bevel on the orange rim, while B's rim and shadow are flatter.
B's leaf and trunk shading is gentler and matte, closer to the real card, while A's leaves and banded trunk have glossy plastic sheen, though A matches the real chunky form turn better.
A's gold trim has a soft lit-to-shadow gradient and a gentle shadow like the real chest, while B is a little more contrasty with a harder dark shadow on the left; the difference is small.
